description: Use this when an agent needs computed SEC EDGAR financials and parsed Form 4 insider trades. Pass symbol (default AAPL). kind="intuitive" (default): latest quarter + Form 4; kind="stats": TTM + history; kind="pro": restatement-aware series + compare; kind="signals": acceleration + Form 4 flags. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), stats (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), signals (33 sats or $0.02 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).
